assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for underlying arrhythmia.
The patient has a diagnosis of transient cerebral ischemic attacks coded as G45.9.
The patient has a diagnosis coded as R00.2.
The patient has a diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome coded as I49.5.
A cardiac event monitor service with CPT code 93271 is ordered/medically necessary.
The service is directly indicated by the documented symptoms and diagnoses and is not denied for lack of coverage as asserted under PR-204.
